title: reportDamageOnReturn
description: Subscribed to `ToolReturned` on the outbox by `subscribePolicies`, and handed each one by the relay after the return commits. When the condition is `needs_repair` it invokes `ToolService.reportDamage` (TL-LEND-CMD03-H), in that handler's own transaction, with the return note as the damage note, or "Returned needing repair." when there is none. If it fails, the failure is logged, the return stands and the event stays in the outbox for the next relay run; reporting the same damage again is harmless.
